{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|Some strains glow in the dark. Clouds make a good backdrop for them. Though you'd think all the rain would wash them out of the air.|Zan Yant, to Barriss Offee|<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>}}
A '''strain''' of [[Bioluminescence/Legends|bioluminescent]] [[Color/Legends|red]] spores was found in the main spore strata on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. During one night after her arrival at the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]]<ref name="MedStar I" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] was surprised to see the buildings illuminated by the multiple colors from the sky. Since she was unfamiliar with Drongaran spores, [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] surgeon [[Zan Yant]] informed her that some strains of spores could glow in the dark. After their conversation, Offee noticed a crimson strain of spores dominating other colors, and after she left, other spore strands were overwhelmed by the red strain.<ref name="MedStar I" />
